svg.title: 22 Context Engineering — Context Window Optimizer
svg.desc: One in-process Node ESM pipeline that types heterogeneous sources, ranks them by three interchangeable strategies, fits them into a token budget with a 25% output reserve, and assembles an attention-ordered message list — plus three subsystems that are NOT in that path. Every element cites a source line in FACTS.md.

g.text: ③ In-code inputs — no files, no network
① 22-context-engineering — one Node ESM process, 0 dependencies, 0 network calls (4 moves claimed demo.js — Isolate has no module)
④ Return value — nothing is sent anywhere
no LLM call anywhere in src/
within a tier: higher relevanceScore wins
a second enumeration that must not drift;
at most ONE source is ever truncated: pass 2
